sections.heading: Refund CSV / Amount
sections.text: Refund amount: refund is measured in CNY. CR-17 is the amount validation rule.

sections.heading: Refund CSV / Missing values
sections.text: A refund amount of NA is missing. Exclude NA from the valid count and mean.

sections.heading: Refund CSV / Empty result
sections.text: If there are no valid refund amounts, return count 0 and leave the mean empty.

sections.heading: Refund policy / Approval
sections.text: Refund approval applies to the specific report version. Only an approved report can be archived.

sections.heading: Refund policy / Retention
sections.text: Keep an archived refund report for 30 days after approval.

sections.heading: Support routing / Refund archive
sections.text: Refund archive requests are handled by the records desk.

sections.heading: Support routing / Records desk hours
sections.text: The records desk opens at 09:00 on weekdays.

sections.heading: Refund approval FAQ
sections.text: Refund approval and refund report questions are common. This refund approval FAQ links to the policy.

sections.heading: Partner refund retention
sections.text: Keep an archived refund report for 90 days after approval.
